question.text: Fair-value valuation for PMS debt holdings is done via:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** APMI mandates empanelled agencies (CRISIL, ICRA, CARE, etc.) for debt valuation — ensures consistent NAVs. **The Trap:** Historical cost understates; mark-to-market has bid-ask issues. **Cross-Exam Context:** XXI-B depth. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Cross-check agency valuations monthly — if 2 agencies give different values, use the more conservative.
